<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE root [
  <!ELEMENT root (child)*>
  <!ELEMENT child (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % pe "<!-- Parameter entity comment -->">
  %pe;
  <!ENTITY ent "Resolved Entity &subent;">
  <!ENTITY subent "Sub-entity Value">
  <?pi-target processing instruction data?>
]>
<root xmlns="http://example.com/ns1" xmlns:ns2="http://example.com/ns2">
  <!-- Top-level comment exercising parser comments -->
  <?another-pi data="test"?>
  <child ns2:attr="value">
    <![CDATA[ CDATA section containing <tags> and &entities; literally. ]]>
  </child>
  <ns2:child>&ent;</ns2:child>
</root>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE doc [
  <!ELEMENT doc (section+)>
  <!ELEMENT section (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY % ext_param SYSTEM "http://example.com/dtd-part">
  <!ENTITY base_ent "Base Entity">
  <!ENTITY complex_ent "&base_ent; plus extra">
  <?xml-stylesheet type="text/xsl" href="transform.xsl"?>
]>
<doc xmlns="http://example.org/base" xmlns:xml="http://www.w3.org/XML/1998/namespace">
  <!-- Document structure comment -->
  <?target data?>
  <section xml:id="sec1">
    <![CDATA[
      First CDATA block with arbitrary text & symbols.
    ]]>
    &complex_ent;
  </section>
  <section>
    <![CDATA[
      Second CDATA block.
    ]]>
  </section>
</doc>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE catalog [
  <!ELEMENT catalog (item*)>
  <!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY e1 "Value 1">
  <!ENTITY e2 "Value 2 &e1;">
  <!ENTITY % macro "<!ELEMENT item (#PCDATA)>">
  %macro;
  <?catalog-pi action="init"?>
]>
<catalog xmlns="urn:catalog:ns" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink" xmlns:html="http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml">
  <!-- Catalog root element comment -->
  <item xlink:type="simple" xlink:href="http://example.com">
    <![CDATA[
      <html:div>HTML fragment inside CDATA</html:div>
    ]]>
  </item>
  <item>&e2;</item>
  <?custom-pi data="content"?>
</catalog>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0"?>
<!DOCTYPE inventory [
  <!ELEMENT inventory (stock)*>
  <!ELEMENT stock (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY itemA "Alpha">
  <!ENTITY itemB "Beta &itemA;">
  <!NOTATION png SYSTEM "image/png">
  <!ENTITY logo SYSTEM "logo.png" NDATA png>
  <?xml-debug level="verbose"?>
]>
<inventory xmlns="http://inventory.org/ns" xmlns:store="http://inventory.org/store">
  <!-- Inventory header comment -->
  <?store:config mode="strict"?>
  <store:stock>
    <![CDATA[
      Special characters: <script>alert(1)</script> & unparsed.
    ]]>
  </store:stock>
  <stock>&itemB;</stock>
</inventory>
```

```xml
<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<!DOCTYPE archive [
  <!ELEMENT archive (record+)>
  <!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>
  <!ENTITY ent_a "Entity A">
  <!ENTITY ent_b "Entity B &ent_a;">
  <!ENTITY % parser_trick "<!ELEMENT record (#PCDATA)>">
  %parser_trick;
  <?archive-meta version="1.0"?>
]>
<archive xmlns="http://archive.org/schema" xmlns:meta="http://archive.org/meta" xmlns:dig="http://archive.org/digital">
  <!-- Archive description comment -->
  <dig:record dig:type="digital">
    <?dig:action execute?>
    <![CDATA[
      Deep CDATA payload with nested structures and entities &ent_a; inside.
    ]]>
  </dig:record>
  <record>&ent_b;</record>
</archive>
```
